notes.title: Sunlight Accessibility Update
notes.notes:
Sunlight is receiving a major accessibility update! 


Sunlight is becoming accessible to more players. With this update we have added a new set of features to make Sunlight a more inclusive experience for everyone. 



In depth audio descriptions have been created to paint the picture of Sunlight through words, allowing players with vision impairment to experience the walk through the forest. In addition, screen reader support has been added to menus, narrative and gameplay. We have also performed some fixes and tweaks to improve your experience.  



Each tree in Sunlight features a unique voice, and now you will have a voice to guide you every step of the way. 



You can hear more about it and see these features in action here
[previewyoutube="kKJg_dmR3vg;full"][/previewyoutube]


Here are the new features added to Sunlight:

Audio descriptions added to gameplay

Screen reader / text to speech support for menus

Minor bug and performance fixes



Sunlight is a part of the Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025. Check out all the other wonderful games included.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5RC
notes.notes:
Sunlight Changelog

Fixed bugs:
-Fixed a critical bug that prevented progression when playing without internet
-Fixed a visual bug where the bouquet in your hand would flicker

Improvements:
-Included FMOD logo in Boot Sequence
-Updated Credits with some missing names
-Cursor is no longer visible during boot sequence
-Updated Menu background to cover the whole screen
-Decreased bouquet placement delay

New:
-Implemented fallback for if the Player does not have access to Internet

Audio:
-Tweaked birds
-Voice balancing
-Fixed a weird voice issue.
